title: Batteries: producer registration required
summary: A producer making batteries available on the market of a member state, including batteries incorporated into products, must be registered in that member state. Flagged in v1; the full module is v2.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 concerning batteries and waste batteries
sources.note: Article reference inherited from 02-technical-plan §5.1/§5.2, which itself states that article numbers must be verified against EUR-Lex before publishing. Not yet verified.
